remarks: Set in the heart of Westport, 23 Bridge Street offers a rare opportunity to own a character-rich home at a price point that is increasingly hard to find in town. Ideally located just minutes from the Metro-North Railroad train station, this property delivers exceptional everyday convenience for commuters and weekend explorers alike. The home borders over 1.5 acres of town-owned open space, a truly rare feature in this part of Westport so close to the center of town. An in-ground pool adds to the lifestyle appeal (pool photo is digitally rendered). Inside, the home is rich with antique barn-style character dating back to the early 1900s. Signature rooms include a dramatic great room with cathedral ceilings and a striking cobblestone fireplace wall, which flows seamlessly into an enclosed sunroom. At ground level, a walk-out offers exceptional versatility, featuring an additional bedroom, full bath, and partial kitchen. This property presents multiple paths forward: remodel in place, expand, or add an additional level. Plans are available for review, offering buyers a head start on unlocking the home's full potential. Surrounded by luxury shopping, renowned dining, and Westport's elevated lifestyle, this is a compelling opportunity to create long-term value in a premier location. Perfectly positioned minutes from Saugatuck Center, Compo Beach, Longshore Club Park, and downtown Westport-this is historical charm paired with modern convenience, 50 miles from NYC, Welcome Home!
